title: Data Over Opinions
description: We don't guess. Every recommendation, every creative test, every budget allocation is backed by real performance data from 100s of franchise locations.

title: Franchise-First Thinking
description: We don't apply B2B playbooks to franchises. Every system we build accounts for multi-location complexity, local nuance, and franchisee-franchisor dynamics.

title: Radical Transparency
description: You see everything we see. Real-time dashboards, honest performance reviews, and straight talk when something isn't working. No smoke, no mirrors.

title: Speed of Execution
description: Franchisees don't have months to wait for "ramp-up." We launch campaigns within 2 weeks and iterate fast because your locations need leads now, not next quarter.

title: Own the Creative
description: We don't recycle stock photos. Our UGC-powered creative engine produces authentic local content that outperforms corporate creative by 30-50% on CPL.

title: Long-Term Partnership
description: 90%+ retention isn't an accident. We build relationships, not campaigns. Your dedicated CSM knows your brand, your markets, and your goals inside and out.
